name: Taming the Beast
summary: Quel'ana Quickgale gives you one last trial in taming a Vuldren Alpha. Mastering it prepares you for the deeper teachings of your class.

sections.title: The Final Trial
sections.body: Quel'ana gives you a Taming Rod and sends you to the Gustberry Lowlands. There, you are to tame a Vuldren Alpha. Then return the rod to him in Valanaar. This trial proves your mastery and prepares you for deeper class teachings.

sections.title: A New Lesson
sections.body: After you return, Quel'ana says you have learned the basics. He offers to teach you to form a lasting bond with an animal companion. He urges you to carry that knowledge forward for the good of the class Zephras Isle needs.

faq.q: What does Quel'ana ask me to tame?
faq.answer: Quel'ana asks you to tame a Vuldren Alpha with the Taming Rod in the Gustberry Lowlands.

faq.q: Where do I find the Vuldren Alpha?
faq.answer: The Vuldren Alpha is in the Gustberry Lowlands.

faq.q: What is the Taming Rod for?
faq.answer: Quel'ana gives you the Taming Rod to tame a Vuldren Alpha.

faq.q: Where do I return the Taming Rod?
faq.answer: Return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.

faq.q: What will I learn after this?
faq.answer: Quel'ana says he can teach you to form a lasting bond with an animal companion.

attribution: In-game quest text: Taming the Beast
